tasks.title: Progressive no-JS mobile nav toggle with menu/close icons
tasks.end_state: SiteHeader has a progressively-enhanced mobile nav disclosure toggle (the P02A-proved pattern): base CSS (no data-nav-ready) → links visible inline, trigger hidden; enhanced ([data-nav-ready]) → trigger revealed with icon-menu, links collapse into a disclosure that opens/closes, icon-close when open; JS binds handlers FIRST (click toggle, link close, Escape+focus-return), THEN sets data-nav-ready on the header. aria-expanded/aria-controls on the toggle. The only client script is this nav-toggle IIFE (progressively enhanced; base works without it). No-JS build: links visible, no toggle. JS build: toggle works. Reduced-motion respected. B2's no-script assertion updated atomically to permit only the nav-toggle IIFE. Failure injection: nav-init failure (addEventListener throws) → data-nav-ready absent → links visible, trigger hidden.
